nodes.name: Form Trigger - Input Content
nodes.notes: Added 'Post to Social Media?' field so you can choose per run whether to auto-schedule via Buffer or just get Slack drafts.

nodes.name: Post to Buffer?
nodes.notes: Routes to Buffer if user selected 'Yes - schedule via Buffer'. Otherwise goes straight to Slack drafts only.

nodes.name: Prepare LinkedIn Posts
nodes.notes: Formats each LinkedIn post as a single text block ready for Buffer API.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.bufferText, profile_ids: ['YOUR_BUFFER_LINKEDIN_PROFILE_ID'], scheduled_at: new Date(Date.now() + ($json.postIndex * 2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)).toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Schedule LinkedIn via Buffer
nodes.notes: SETUP: 1) Go to buffer.com → sign up free → connect LinkedIn. 2) Go to buffer.com/developers → get your Access Token. 3) Replace YOUR_BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN with your token. 4) Replace YOUR_BUFFER_LINKEDIN_PROFILE_ID with your LinkedIn profile ID from Buffer API (GET https://api.bufferapp.com/1/profiles.json). Posts are spaced 2 days apart automatically.

nodes.name: Prepare Tweets
nodes.notes: Formats each tweet ready for Buffer API.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.bufferText, profile_ids: ['YOUR_BUFFER_TWITTER_PROFILE_ID'], scheduled_at: new Date(Date.now() + ($json.tweetIndex * 1 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)).toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Schedule Tweets via Buffer
nodes.notes: SETUP: 1) Connect Twitter/X in buffer.com. 2) Replace YOUR_BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN with your Buffer token. 3) Replace YOUR_BUFFER_TWITTER_PROFILE_ID with your Twitter profile ID from Buffer API. Tweets are spaced 1 day apart automatically.

nodes.name: Send to Slack
nodes.notes: SETUP: Connect your Slack OAuth2 credential. Replace YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID with your channel ID.

nodes.name: Save to Google Drive
nodes.notes: SETUP: Use same Google Drive credential. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID with your content folder ID.
